parts.provenance: Original work authored through SolidCraft's commands over plain parameters by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` (saved at the DM3D-style starter row); the microsd generator gives every value. Proportions follow Hirose's public DM3 series catalogue (p. 9, DM3D push-pull, https://mm.digikey.com/Volume0/opasdata/d220001/medias/docus/9054/DM3.pdf, retrieved 18 November 2026), compared with Hirose's public product photo; sheet, insulator and contact springs are estimated. No vendor CAD, image or EDA library data copied.
